samples.xml_description:
<module id="fixed_point_subtractor">
    <description>Fixed-point subtractor for performing precise arithmetic operations.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[N-1:0]">First N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[N-1:0]">Second N-bit fixed-point input operand.</input>
        <output id="c" width_description="[N-1:0]">Resulting N-bit fixed-point output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter name="Q">Number of fractional bits in the fixed-point representation.</parameter>
        <parameter name="N">Total number of bits used for inputs and outputs.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[N-1:0]" />
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Internal signals for different sign subtraction
        reg [N-1:0] abs_a;
        reg [N-1:0] abs_b;
        
        // Subtract the two operands based on their signs
        if (a[N-1] == b[N-1]) begin
            res <= {a[N-1], a[N-2:0]} - {b[N-1], b[N-2:0]};
        end else begin
            // Handle different sign subtraction
            if ((a[N-1] > b[N-1]) || (a[N-1] == 0 && b[N-1] == 1)) begin
                res <= a + (~b + 1);
                res[N-1] <= 0;
            end else begin
                res <= ~a + 1 + b;
                res[N-1] <= 1;
            end
        end
        
        // Set the sign bit of the result to 0 if it is 0
        if (res == 0) begin
            res[N-1] <= 0;
        end
    </implementation>
    
</module>
